blind.description: A single rectangular kneeler or floor cushion with rounded corners and a slightly indented, tufted top. The body is upholstered in deep red mottled fabric or leather, bordered around the top rim with gold or yellow piping. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled, sitting flat directly on the floor without any extra base.
blind.from_above: A soft-cornered rectangular red cushion framed by a thin gold border, featuring a subtle central depression.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3 to 4 inches tall (less than 1/15 the height of the figure) and roughly 1.3 feet wide.
